# Job Board Scraper

> Collect the open roles on a company's own career site and detect what opened or closed since the last run.

- Actor: data_foundry/job-board-scraper
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/job-board-scraper
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: Jobs
- Pricing: $10 per 1,000 companies scanned; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: company slugs
- Output: open roles plus a per-company hiring signal
- Run: apify call data_foundry/job-board-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~job-board-scraper/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
